text:
morgan: Quick poll — anyone have a spare capture card we can borrow for Saturdays LAN bakeoff? want to record the chaotic Smash tourney.

devon: I have an Elgato HD60 S+ but need it Sunday morning back for a stream. can lend for a few hours Saturday afternoon.

nina: im down to borrow if needed, ive got a cheap USB3 card that handles 720p fine.

morgan: awesome. planning: bring consoles 2:30pm, warm-up until 3:15 then tourney starts. will do double-elim, best of 3.

oscar: can anyone bring an ethernet switch? wifi lag killed last time. also power strips please.

devon: @oscar ill bring a 5-port switch + an extra surge protector.

nina: whos handling bracket signups? i can run Challonge if people want easy links.

morgan: @nina yes please. also tagging @devon for capture card handoff logistics.

oscar: reminder: office kitchen rule — no greasy controllers near keyboards. we will enforce with shame-based policing :grimacing: 

deploy-bot: Reminder: Friday 17:00 — infra deploy to prod (no noisy maintenance expected).

morgan: ok cool — nobody schedule a long-running render during the tourney :sweat_smile:

devon: capture card handoff: ill leave it labeled at reception by 2pm. return to same spot by 6pm.

nina: signed up for bracket admin. sending link in #random in a sec.

oscar: ill bring shields (controller covers) and a small speaker. anyone allergic to peanuts? planning snacks.

morgan: peanut-free snacks noted. thanks yall, hype for chaotic finals :trophy:
